DIPLOMAT®

Thoracolumbar Posterior Pedicle Screw Fixation · Theatre App

Modular two-piece screw & tulip

Double-thread polyaxial pedicle screw system. Tulip is exchangeable in situ — standard, reduction or MIS — onto any screw, once only.

ELASTOLOK® lock
i

Indications. Degenerative disc disease, spondylolisthesis, trauma, stenosis, deformity, tumours & pseudarthrosis of the thoracolumbar spine. Single use only — use SIGNUS instruments & the 11Nm torque limiter for every set screw; the rod must not be re-bent once removed.

Tulip & Head Hardware

exchangeable in situ, once
Three named tulips, one screw platform — press firmly onto the screw shank until an audible “CLICK”, then pull-test to confirm.
Standard tulip — Art. AB0010-55001. Ø12.5×14.9mm, lowest profile available. ELASTOLOK® locking mechanism. Ideal for young / slim patients.

Reduction tulip — Art. AB0020-55001. Ø12.5×32.2mm, up to 17mm rod reduction, breakaway tabs. Also suits tissue-sparing Wiltse paraspinal access.

Percutaneous tulip — Art. AB0030-55001. For the MIS/percutaneous technique — breakaway tabs, shortenable in-situ with the MIS break-off sleeve (AC0120).

In-situ assembly with the tulip assembly instrument (AC0081) or disassembly with the tulip disassembly instrument (AC0129-H) — each tulip removed & re-attached once only, then discard.
Double thread4.5mm displacement / turn — faster insertion
Self-tappingStrong purchase without pre-tap
50° polyaxial angulationGenerous trajectory tolerance at the tulip
8,206N tensile strengthASTM F1798-97 · screw/tulip connection
Cannulated Ø1.9mmFrom Ø5.5mm · guide wire Ø1.8×252mm
AugmentableVertebroplasty cement, Ø5.5mm+, max 2ml/screw
i

PROTEUS® retractor blades are compatible with the DIPLOMAT® tulip geometry for combined open/MIS exposures.

Rods

Ø5.5mm
Straight, 500mm. Cobalt chrome (Art. AB1855-00500) or Titanium (Art. LSZ3000) — cut to length in theatre. Pre-contour with the bendable rod template (AC0082).
Curved, titanium. 30mm (AB0955-00030) & 125mm (AB0955-00125) — pre-contoured for sacro-iliac / long constructs.
DIPLOMAT® MIS uses dedicated percutaneous rod articles, sized as functional rod length — see Technique · MIS · step 3.

Set Screw

T30 · self-retaining
Set screw, T30 drive. Art. AB0140-55000. Definitive tightening: SIGNUS handle + 11Nm torque limiter, to an audible click.
i

VBR tip. 25mm short screws (Ø4.5/5.5/6.5/7.5mm) are available for vertebral-body-replacement cases used with SIGNUS POSEIDON® ST.

Connector Family

sterile
Telescopic cross-connector. Rotational stability for long segments. Outer screws first, centre screw last — torque-limited to 2.5Nm (AC0051-1-A + sleeve AC0051-2).
SizeRangeColour
S35–45mm
M41–58mm
L54–82mm
Offset connector. Ø5.5mm — compensates screw-to-rod distance / iliac fixation offset. L15 · L20 · L25 · L30mm — fix with set screws at 11Nm.
Extension sleeve / inline connector. Ø5.5mm — extends an existing rod for staged / subsequent treatment. Torque limiter 5Nm (AC0027-1/-2).
Parallel connector. Closed, 4-screw fixation. Ø4.5×5.5 · Ø5.5×5.5 · Ø5.5×6.0mm rod combinations.
Parallel connector UU NEW. Open variant — Ø5.5×5.5 & Ø5.5×6.0mm rod combinations, fixed with set screws at 11Nm.
i

Augmentation. Augmentable screws (Ø5.5mm+) accept low-viscosity bone cement for vertebroplasty via the alignment device (AC0040-H) and INTROX® HighV cannula. Apply slowly under continuous fluoroscopic control — stop immediately if a leak is seen.

!

Never insert without a tulip fitted. Each tulip: remove & re-attach once only.

1Preparation

Awl (SN0010-B) opens the pedicle; probe the tract (SN0021). Entry angle: thoracolumbar 5–10°, L2 ≈10°, L5 ≈15°.

With guide wire: threaded awl Ø5.5/6.5/7.5 (AC0085/86/87) on palm handle AC0073-1-A, opens & threads the pedicle, depth marks from 20mm. Remove obturator, pass guide wire AC0125-A.

Threaded awl — opens pedicle & cuts thread, depth marks from 20mm.

2Implanting the screw

Click the standard (AB0010), reduction (AB0020) or percutaneous (AB0030) tulip onto the screw — pull-test to confirm.

Press to a “CLICK”, then pull-test.

Attaching the Screwdriver

1

Fit handle (AC0073-1-A) to screwdriver AC0090-1-H.

2

PUSH sets tulip length — up for percutaneous/reduction, down for standard.

3

Turn clockwise hand-tight, then drive into bone — sleeve guides trajectory.

4

To release: turn anticlockwise and withdraw.

Without tulip: driver AC0072-1/-2-H ± head cutter AC0071-H, attach tulip in-situ with AC0081. Exchange tulip: AC0129-H, once only.

●Removing the tulip

Back the screw off 1–2 turns so the tulip is free. Connect disassembly instrument AC0129-H on the same axis and rotate — no force — until it detaches. Re-attach the new tulip the same way (AC0081), then pull-test. Once only per tulip.

3Implanting the rod

Contour with rod template (AC0082) + bending pliers (500028), or in-situ irons (AC0058/59-A). Align tulips (AC0015-H), insert with rod holders (500027), seat with rod fork (AC0021-H).

In-situ bending irons — AC0058-A / AC0059-A.

4Reduction tower

Assemble AC0100-1/-2/-3-H + AC0115 on T-handle AC0031-WA. Insert on tulip; clamp confirms fixed. Clockwise reduces, anticlockwise + withdraw releases.

Outer sleeve, inner sleeve, rotary knob — clamp notches seat the tulip.

5Finalisation

Set screwdriver AC0017-H — provisionally tighten all screws first.

Self-retaining driver seats the set screw through the counter-torque.

●Final tightening — 11 Nm

Handle AC0032-C + counter-torque AC0020-H, to an audible CLICK. Caudal-left, then clockwise round the construct.

●Removing tulip tabs

Tab remover AC0118-H (1 percutaneous / 5 reduction tabs). MIS: use the persuader AC0119 instead.

6Connector family

Cross-connector, offset connector, extension sleeve / parallel connector — see Rods & Connectors tab.

Sleeve AC0051-2, rotate 90° to a CLICK. Outer screws first at 2.5Nm (AC0051-1-A), centre screw last.

Offset connector, iliac fixation — match length (L15–L30), secure at 11Nm.

7Additional techniques

Distraction/compression. Distractor MP0010 / compressor MP0011, or modular 570500/501-A (valves 6–73mm).

Cement augmentation. Screws over guide wire → alignment device AC0040-H → INTROX® HighV cement, cannula SM-SF1820 (≈1.48ml). Stop immediately if a leak is seen.

Modular distractor/compressor 570500/501-A with matched blades.

i

OSIRION® I. Continuous neuromonitoring during screw placement — traffic-light display.

DIPLOMAT® MIS. Same screw & tulip system as open, via dedicated MIS instruments.

!

Guide wire: never advance/withdraw mid-manipulation. Keep in place until trajectory is secure.

1Preparation

≈2cm incision; dilators AC0110 / AC0111-H. Threaded awl opens pedicle (Open, step 1). Replace obturator with guide wire AC0125/126-A under X-ray.

Threaded awl through the dilator sleeves — depth off the shaft markings.

Screw length ruler (AC0127) over the guide wire — read laser mark against scale.

2Implanting the screw

Same as open — percutaneous tulip (AB0030), CLICK, pull-test. See Open, step 2.

3Implanting the rod

MIS rod template (AC0117-1/-2) through outer tulips — read functional rod length on upper scale.

Template spans the two outer tulips — read length before cutting.

Fixing element AC0153-1-H into rod holder AC0153-2-H (align laser marks); fix rod with screwdriver AC0054-H + handle AC0030-WA. Align tulips first (AC0022-H).

Align laser marks on fixing element & holder before fixing the rod.

Keep rod vertical, rotate down through muscle into tulips under X-ray. Not seated? Push home with reduction tower.

4Finalisation

MIS tulip sleeve (AC0121-A) over tulips first — stops spreading & early tab breakage.

Sleeve over all three tulips before driving set screws.

Set screwdriver AC0018-H hand-tight (laser mark flush = seated). Remove safety sleeves, final-tighten AC0017-H + 11Nm handle AC0032-C on counter-torque AC0020-H.

Break off tabs with the persuader AC0119.

Persuader AC0119 — breaks tulip tabs without bending the tulip.

5Compression / distraction

Combined compressor/distractor MP1031-A + sleeve AC0124. Definitively tighten only one set screw as the fixed point.

One instrument, both manoeuvres, marked on the frame.

!

Curved rods can cross proximally once set screws are seated. Use straight rods for distraction/compression.
